feedback: The large promotional hero displaced help links from the first screen.
Category-only cards required extra navigation to reach specific tutorials.
Distinct category symbols and a direct popular breadboard entry were requested.
decisions: Replace the hero/features frontmatter with a compact Markdown directory inside the default VitePress home layout.
Expose five frequent tasks: provisioning/binding, online building/flashing, v2.6.0 downloads, basic S3 breadboard assembly, and troubleshooting.
Link the breadboard shortcut directly to the established ESP32-S3 build; retain direct C3, classic ESP32, LCD, camera, and 4G entries in hardware.
Show all 44 sidebar guide entries directly in nine visible categories, plus eight symptom anchors and the first-use overview.
Use nine shared native SVG category icons; retain text labels and avoid large decorative images.
Place firmware/downloads early and retain a visible FAQ column on desktop. Use one column on narrow screens.
Update the English homepage against the Chinese content and refresh only its reviewed source hash.
Export the body-based homepage once in machine-readable Markdown, without adding a duplicate hero heading.
scope: Homepage navigation and presentation only. Article IDs, paths, technical instructions, editorial statuses, and hardware-verification limits are unchanged.
